description: Several colorful plastic cups sit on the table (yellow and red in the back, a green one to the right), with a yellow squeeze bottle and a blue cleaning sponge nearby. The right hand holds the blue cup near the center while the left hand brings the yellow bottle toward the cup’s opening, then sets the bottle down and picks up the blue sponge to push it into the cup; both hands steady and rotate the cup slightly as the sponge scrubs around inside, making the cup a two-hand object during the cleaning.
